reader.notes: Relative page headings follow the 1985 rule (the runtime places them from the RH's final LINE-COUNTER, NEXT GROUP included), and an absolute PH above HEADING is refused. GroupLimits gives the page heading HEADING at every edition, and the RH's lower limit uses the PH's first line, not the RH's NEXT GROUP setting, so an absolute PH line between the RH's last line and its NEXT GROUP setting compiles and prints (ph6e). The 1985 text of this rule is a reconstruction (kb/Work PB4952); the finding stands on it and on the printed GR5 a and XIII.3.16.4 GR4.
